base_value_source: 01_historical-financials.md §2 (TTM EBIT, TTM ended Jun-30-2026; cross-checked to CIQ Financials_Annual.xls LTM column)

sensitivities.label: Driver/Courier/Carrier variable payments (cost of revenue) as % of revenue
sensitivities.non_linearity: Largest single cost line (55-61% of revenue); an adverse move driven by competitive pressure to defend driver/courier supply liquidity may be sticky and hard to reverse quickly (business-model/06_value-chain.md §1).

sensitivities.label: Ex-UK YoY revenue growth rate (proxy for Trip/Gross Bookings volume)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient assumes a ~30% incremental EBIT margin, inferred from FY24->FY25 (34.4%) and Q2'25->Q2'26 (28.6%) actual incremental margins, not company-disclosed. In a volume slowdown, driver/courier incentive spend may not de-lever proportionally (supply-liquidity floor), so the true bear-case coefficient could be more negative than this symmetric estimate.

sensitivities.label: FX translation effect on YoY revenue growth
sensitivities.unit: pp of reported vs constant-currency growth
sensitivities.non_linearity: Revenue-level effect only. EBIT-level impact is not separately disclosed; local revenue and local operating costs both move with the same currency, so translation effects likely net out substantially at the operating-margin level - no FX-to-EBIT coefficient is asserted.
